pred_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS seller_count FROM sellers WHERE seller_state = 'RJ';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS five_star_reviews_2017 FROM reviews WHERE review_score = 5 AND review_creation_date >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01' AND review_creation_date < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
SELECT customer_state, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', order_purchase_timestamp), '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-07-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled' AND order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'

SELECT p.category_en AS category, COUNT(*) AS items_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01' AND p.category_en IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.category_en ORDER BY items_sold DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT AVG(item_count) AS avg_items_per_delivered_order
FROM (
  SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS item_count
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  GROUP BY o.order_id
) t;

SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS total_sales_2017
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_orders, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS late_delivery_rate_pct FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-11-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2017-12-01' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL

SELECT AVG(DATEDIFF('day', o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date)) AS avg_delivery_time_days
FROM orders o
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-03-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-04-01'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL;

WITH customer_orders AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n_orders
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN n_orders > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_repeat_customers,
  SUM(CASE WHEN n_orders > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_customers,
  COUNT(*) AS total_customers
FROM customer_orders;

WITH order_reviews AS (
  SELECT order_id, AVG(review_score) AS avg_score
  FROM reviews
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 'late' ELSE 'on_time' END AS delivery_timing,
  COUNT(*) AS orders_with_reviews,
  ROUND(AVG(r.avg_score), 3) AS avg_review_score
FROM orders o
JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.review_id) AS low_ratings
FROM reviews r
WHERE r.review_score <= 2
  AND r.review_creation_date >= TIMESTAMP '2018-07-01'
  AND r.review_creation_date < TIMESTAMP '2018-10-01';

SELECT oi.seller_id, s.seller_city, s.seller_state, ROUND(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value), 2) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY oi.seller_id, s.seller_city, s.seller_state
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH customer_orders AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_unique_id,
        o.order_id,
        o.order_purchase_timestamp
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
),
first_order AS (
    SELECT
        customer_unique_id,
        MIN(order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_order_ts
    FROM customer_orders
    GROUP BY customer_unique_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co.customer_unique_id) AS repeat_customers_2017_to_2018
FROM customer_orders co
JOIN first_order fo ON co.customer_unique_id = fo.customer_unique_id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM fo.first_order_ts) = 2017
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM co.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT r.region,
         p.category_en AS category,
         SUM(oi.price) AS gmv
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN regions r ON r.state = c.customer_state
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
    AND o.order_status = 'delivered'
  GROUP BY r.region, p.category_en
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT region, category, gmv,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY gmv DESC) AS rn
  FROM base
)
SELECT region, category, gmv
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY region, gmv DESC;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    oi.order_id,
    s.seller_state,
    CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS late
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
    AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  seller_state,
  COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders,
  ROUND(AVG(late) * 100, 2) AS late_rate_pct
FROM base
GROUP BY seller_state
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100
ORDER BY late_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH seller_gmv AS (
  SELECT i.seller_id, i.price, i.freight_value
  FROM order_items i
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(price + freight_value) AS total_gmv FROM seller_gmv
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT seller_id, SUM(price + freight_value) AS gmv,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(price + freight_value) DESC) AS rnk
  FROM seller_gmv
  GROUP BY seller_id
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN rnk <= 20 THEN gmv ELSE 0 END) / MAX(total_gmv), 2) AS top20_sellers_gmv_pct
FROM ranked
CROSS JOIN total;

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
         SUM(oi.price) AS gmv
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-12-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-09-01'
  GROUP BY 1
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT month, gmv,
         LAG(gmv) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_gmv
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT month,
       gmv,
       prev_month_gmv,
       ROUND(100.0 * (gmv - prev_month_gmv) / prev_month_gmv, 2) AS mom_growth_pct
FROM lagged
WHERE month >= DATE '2018-01-01'
ORDER BY month;

SELECT count(*) AS orders_with_multiple_sellers
FROM (
    SELECT order_id
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
    HAVING count(DISTINCT seller_id) > 1
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS unique_customers_2018
FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01';

WITH voucher_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT order_id
  FROM payments
  WHERE payment_type = 'voucher'
),
order_totals AS (
  SELECT p.order_id, SUM(p.payment_value) AS total_paid
  FROM payments p
  JOIN voucher_orders v ON p.order_id = v.order_id
  GROUP BY p.order_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_paid) AS avg_paid_per_order
FROM order_totals;

WITH mg_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT oi.order_id
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
  WHERE s.seller_state = 'MG'
),
order_reviews AS (
  SELECT order_id, AVG(review_score) AS avg_review
  FROM reviews
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.avg_review), 4) AS avg_review_score_mg_sellers
FROM mg_orders o
JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id;

SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS total_health_beauty_sales_2017
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE p.category_en ILIKE '%health%beauty%'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01';

SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(AVG(epoch(o.order_delivered_customer_date - o.order_purchase_timestamp) / 86400.0), 2) AS avg_wait_days FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id AND s.seller_state = 'SP') GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY avg_wait_days DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT AVG(epoch(order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp) / 86400.0) AS avg_delivery_days, COUNT(*) AS orders_count FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL;
